login.title: Log In
login.subtitle: Access Yemen's unified ERP & Bank gateway
login.demoHint: Click a person to fill email and password. Then log in. Dummy OTP is 123456.

otp.title: Verify Your Identity
otp.subtitle: We emailed a 6-digit code to your registered email address. Please enter it below.
otp.invalid: That code is not valid. Dummy console accepts 123456.

forgot.title: Forgot Password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email address and we will send you a secure link to reset your credentials.

sent.title: Check Your Email
sent.subtitle: We have sent a secure password reset link to your email address. Please check your inbox and click the link to continue.

reset.title: Create New Password
reset.subtitle: Set a secure, unique password for accessing your merchant aggregator workspace.
reset.hint: Minimum 8 characters, including letters and numbers.
reset.mismatch: Passwords must match and include letters and numbers.

resetSuccess.title: Password updated
resetSuccess.subtitle: Your password has been reset. Sign in with your new credentials.

locked.title: Account Locked
locked.subtitle: Too many incorrect attempts. Your account has been locked for 3 hours. Please try again later or contact our institutional merchant support.

register.title: Create Your Merchant Account
register.subtitle: Join Yemen's unified ERP & Bank aggregator gateway
register.invalid: Fill every field. Password must be at least 8 characters and match the confirmation.

pending.title: Application received
pending.subtitle: Your merchant account stays pending until two different platform operators complete maker-checker approval. You cannot sign in until then.

dashboard.title: Dashboard

intro.operator: Pending maker-checker work, active merchants, and payment-point approval SLA (1 working day).
intro.merchant: Your Al-Amal Pharmacies payment points, integration user, and notification delivery.
intro.institution: Tadhamon Bank approvals, live points, and notification traffic for this month.

dashboard.errorsIntro: These buttons hit dummy endpoints. The error interceptor routes each status to its page.

users.title: Platform Operators
users.intro: Invite-only staff on the hardcoded @aggregator.ye domain. Admin never acts as Maker. Only Admin can open this page. Maker / Checker / Reader cannot manage operators.
users.search: Search name, email, city, or role
users.name: Operator Name

products.title: Merchants
products.intro: Self-service and operator-assisted onboardings. Login is blocked until maker-checker approval. CR number is the verification key.
products.search: Search name, CR, city, or ERP
products.name: Legal name

merchants.title: Merchant Management
merchants.intro: Self-service and operator-assisted onboardings. Login is blocked until maker-checker approval. CR number is enough to approve in MVP1 — no documents required.
merchants.name: Legal name

orders.title: Payment points
orders.intro: Wallet numbers and merchant point numbers. A point stays pending until the linked bank or wallet approves it. Currencies: USD, SAR, YER.
orders.search: Search point code, merchant, or institution
orders.empty: No payment points match that search.

points.title: Payment Points
points.intro: Merchant requests a point. The bank or wallet has one working day to approve. Confirmation is a code, QR, or a tap on the notification. Currencies: USD, SAR, YER.
points.search: Search point code, merchant, or institution
points.empty: No payment points match that search.
points.mineIntro: Wallet numbers and merchant points for Al-Amal Pharmacies. The linked bank or wallet has one working day to approve.
points.approvalsIntro: Pending points that Tadhamon Bank must approve or reject within one working day.
points.institutionIntro: Every merchant point and wallet number linked to Tadhamon Bank in the dummy set.

erp.title: All ERP Systems
erp.intro: ERP vendors that connect merchants into the aggregator. Checker or Admin can approve a pending connector.
erp.empty: No ERP systems match that search.
erp.name: System Name
erp.banner: Only approved ERP systems appear in merchant sign-up.

requests.title: Integration user requests
requests.intro: API users requested by merchants, banks, wallets, or ERP vendors. Maker submits; Checker or Admin approves.
requests.empty: No integration requests match that search.

reports.title: Reports / audit log
reports.intro: Dummy trail of maker-checker actions, FI approvals, and merchant requests.
reports.empty: No audit events match that search.

notes.merchantIntro: Payment notifications posted to Al-Amal Pharmacies points. Completed, pending, or failed.
notes.webhookNote: The platform will push real-time payment notifications to your ERP endpoint once approved by the Platform Operator.
notes.fiIntro: Read-only log of payment notifications delivered via Integration API

integration.title: Integration User
integration.fiIntro: Manage secure credentials and endpoints for Financial Institution API integration.
integration.intro: Machine user that posts or reads payment notifications for your organisation.
integration.empty: No integration user is provisioned for this account.
integration.reasonPh: Please explain why you need to modify your integration credentials or URLs...
integration.checkerNote: Changes require Platform Operator approval (maker-checker process).
integration.otpNote: Unmasking credentials requires OTP verification sent to your registered email {{email}}.
integration.regenerateHint: Self-service. Triggers OTP verification, then issues new credentials immediately.
integration.requestDetailHint: Changes to URL or Port require Platform Operator approval (maker-checker process).
integration.regenerateWarn: This will invalidate your current credentials immediately. A new set will be generated after successful OTP verification.

profile.fiIntro: Review contract terms and manage institution contact representative details

settings.title: Account Settings
settings.intro: Dummy profile for the signed-in user. Roles follow the BRD: Admin never Maker; Checker approves; Reader is read-only.
settings.fiIntro: Update login credentials and security settings
settings.readerNote: Reader accounts cannot approve or mutate records. Navigation hides Platform Operators.
settings.rulesIntro: In compliance with Tadhamon Bank and Ultimate pay security audit requirements, passwords must meet the following:
settings.emailNotifHint: Receive approvals pending checker and audit warning emails.
settings.smsNotifHint: Receive instant alerts on critical security modifications.

institutions.title: Financial Institution Management
institutions.intro: Licensed financial institutions that send payment notifications into the aggregator.
institutions.search: Search name, license, city, or type
institutions.name: Institution Name

401.title: Unauthorized
401.message: Your session is missing or the JWT is no longer valid. Sign in again to continue.

404.title: Page not found
404.message: That route does not exist, or the dummy API returned 404 for the resource you asked for.

501.title: Not implemented
501.message: This capability is not wired yet. The mock API returned 501 so you can style the empty feature state.

503.title: Service unavailable
503.message: The dummy backend is pretending to be down. Retry in a moment or return to a working screen.

validation.pattern: That value is not in the expected format.
validation.passwordStrength: Use at least 8 characters with letters and numbers.
validation.phone: Enter a phone number with at least 7 digits.

toast.welcome: You're in. Let's get Yemen's rails moving.
toast.otpSent: A fresh 6-digit code is on its way. The demo console accepts 123456.
toast.registerOk: Request received. We'll email you once a checker reviews the application.
toast.registerBad: We couldn't save the application. Check the form and try again.
toast.resetSent: If that inbox is on file, a reset link is on its way.
toast.passwordUpdated: Password updated. Sign in with the new one whenever you're ready.
toast.changeRequested: Change request is with a checker.
toast.credsRegenerated: New integration credentials are ready. Copy them now — the old pair no longer works.
toast.loginBad: That email, password, or portal tab doesn't match. Pick the right audience and try again.
toast.otpBad: That code isn't right. The demo console accepts 123456.
toast.forbidden: You don't have permission for that. Ask a checker or an admin.
toast.server: Something hiccuped on our side. Give it a moment and try again.
toast.network: We couldn't reach the gateway. Check your connection and retry.
toast.badRequest: A few fields still need a look. Check the form and try again.
toast.notFound: We couldn't find that record. It may have moved or already been actioned.
toast.operatorBad: Invite needs a complete name and an @aggregator.ye work email.
toast.merchantSubmitted: Merchant is in the checker queue. They can't sign in until approved.
toast.fiSubmitted: Institution is waiting on a checker. Only approved banks and wallets show in merchant onboarding.
toast.erpSubmitted: ERP connector is queued for review. It stays off the sign-up list until approved.
toast.operatorInvited: Invite sent. They'll show as Invited until their first login.
toast.pointSubmitted: Payment point is with the bank. They have one working day to approve.

approved.merchant: Merchant is live. Their ERP can start routing payments.
approved.institution: Institution is live on the rails.
approved.erp: ERP connector is approved and will show on merchant sign-up.

rejected.merchant: Merchant request was declined. They'll see the decision on their next visit.
rejected.erp: ERP connector was declined and stays off the sign-up list.

onboard.fiCrumb: Financial Institution Management > Onboard New FI
onboard.operatorDomain: The work email must match the platform approved domain (@aggregator.ye).
onboard.operatorError: Invite failed. Use an @aggregator.ye email and fill every field.
onboard.pointCrumb: My Payment Points > Add Payment Point
onboard.pointNote: Note: Only banks/FIs approved by the Platform Operator are listed. Your payment point will be reviewed before activation.
onboard.submitError: Could not submit. Check the fields and try again.

detail.merchantWarning: The Commercial Registration (CR) number is the sole basis for merchant verification. Please cross-reference this with the Ministry database before approving.
detail.pointWarning: Verify the wallet/account number matches the merchant's registered bank details before approving.
detail.missing: This record could not be found.
